reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: Absolutely ridiculous. Emailed support three times with no response. App is not user friendly anymore. No profile or account options. *account stuck in partner pairing * no unlink option * support unresponsive * contact form broken. Don’t bother buying a subscription.
